## Research Interests

Mathematical biology, pattern formation, differential equations, graph theory, and computational modeling.

## Research

### Graph-Based Models of Morphogen Diffusion in Butterfly Wing Development

- Investigating mathematical models of butterfly wing pattern formation through geometry, graph representations, and computational modeling.
- Developing computational methods to extract wing structure from photographs for comparison with mathematical models.
- Raising and documenting painted lady butterflies while studying developmental biology and pattern formation.

### Nonlinear Preferential Attachment in Collaboration Networks

- Developing an agent-based model of collaboration networks to study the emergence of structural inequality through nonlinear preferential attachment.
- Designed Monte Carlo experiments to investigate the effects of attachment bias on network growth and degree inequality.

## Technical Skills

Python, C++, LaTeX, Java, and C.
